long_biography.plain_text:
Valerio Zamboni learnt the aircraft market from inside the cockpit, flying Falcon jets for a Milan charter operator and later managing flight operations. He then worked in aeroplane sales, first alongside an American partner. His own venture began with Learjet representation in Italy and grew to encompass the Challenger and Global ranges in several European countries.

The partnership he established in Monte Carlo made him its manager and majority holder. It later converted into a share company, while the operation shifted from exclusive manufacturer representation towards client advice and used-aircraft brokerage. He continues as chief executive. Outside work, he has pursued ultra-distance cycling at a competitive level, taking on Race Across America and Race Around Ireland.
